add_device.description: List of devices to add, in format '<device>::<type>::<extra_args>'. Use with --no-scan to specify only certain drives.

add_virtual.description: List of files containing smartctl output, interpreted as read-only virtual devices.

desktop.description: Desktop environment for selecting native su mechanism. Valid values: auto, kde, gnome, other.

no_scan.description: Skip automatic device scanning on startup.

verbosity_level.description: Set verbosity level (0–5). Ignored if verbose or quiet is set.

no_sanitize.description: Disable path sanitization for debug (not documented but used internally in some builds).
